tickets.title: EFTPOS terminal card-read failure — store 0067 checkout 1 (resolved, feeds known-error pattern)
tickets.description: Historical resolved incident of the same EFTPOS card-read fault pattern. Root cause and fix captured in SOP-EFTPOS-TERM-FAULT-001, which is now used by the Knowledge Agent to ground guidance for new matching incidents (see INC-2026-08872).

requested_by.verification_method: Entra ID deterministic verification (employee ID + DOB challenge)

channel_detail.voice_confirmation_given: I've logged an incident for the card read failure at checkout 1. Your reference number is INC-2026-08850.

resolution.resolution_notes: Root cause: loose PIN pad cable connection causing intermittent card-read failure, exacerbated by terminal firmware not auto-recovering the connection. Fix: reseat cable and power-cycle terminal; escalate to hardware swap if fault recurs within 48 hours. Findings written back to knowledge base as SOP-EFTPOS-TERM-FAULT-001.
